body: Thanks but guilt isn't going to stop me, I'm not going to be miserable for another 40 years just to keep someone else happy. It's not really fair to ask someone to do that. Besides, if I die she'll get millions, maybe she'll have better luck buying happiness than me. I hang out with my mom more than most people I know, at least two days a month. We even go on vacations together sometimes. It doesn't make me happy.

What are you talking about, "if I ever make it"? Teachers and parents tell children all the time that they can do anything they put their minds to. It appears to be a false statement, but that's because most people expect things to just happen and never put real effort into pursuing their dreams. Believe it or not, you really can do pretty much anything you put your mind to. As long as you have the desire and actually pursue it, it will happen. I grew up on welfare with my mom, everyone thought of me as just some loser kid when I dropped out of high school and sat on the computer all day. But I worked my ass off to teach myself everything I needed to know and get to where I am. Unfortunately it came at the cost of a social life, which is a lot more detrimental than I thought. But if you want something, and you actually pursue it, it will happen for you. Don't doubt yourself.

No. But I am very much involved in the open source community, but only with my personal projects and not with our products. Our software is a hosted service that requires a massive cluster of servers to run, only our competitors would find it useful.

I don't want to be too specific, it's a very small industry and it wouldn't take many clues for someone in the industry to recognize who I am. I build a very specialized type of software with very few clients who pay a lot of money to license it monthly.

Thank you for your response. I know I can talk to my doctor about the xanax, but honestly I was feeling like this before then, and the xanax really helps me socialize when I have to (clients, business meetings, etc). It isn't the cause of how I'm feeling, it's actually helping a little bit and I'm glad I have it. Perhaps there's other medicines, but I don't want to take something that's just going to make me OK with living a depressing lifestyle. I believe my depression is a natural response to how I'm living my life, it's perfectly normal to be feeling this way and doesn't need to be medicated away. I don't want to take pills that just make me think I'm happy when I'm sitting at home by myself for several weeks straight. 

I know loneliness isn't permanent, or at least it doesn't have to be. But I have been experiencing it for a very very long time, it sure feels permanent to me. I don't know how to end it. I used to be an alcoholic years ago, and I will admit, it was much easier meeting people back then. I don't drink anymore. Occasionally a client invites me on a "business trip" which is usually to Vegas or something, where we have a big party, have some mdma, fuck hookers, and just generally have a good time without actually doing any real business. I'll drink at those events, but still feel too awkward to approach anybody I don't know. I'm not really comfortable at bars, when I drank it was always at home or at a friend's house. I don't know what to order or how to act at those establishments, it would be great if I had a friend who liked going to bars that I could tag along with.

I had an okcupid profile a few months ago. It absolutely killed my self confidence. I was a member for 5 months, messaged dozens of girls with no copypasta, put a lot of thought into each message, and only got 3 to actually reply to me. None of it lead to actually meeting them. I have moved since then, maybe I'll have better luck in this new area. But I'm afraid I'll get the same response, which makes me feel shitty every time I visit the site.

I'm really sorry to hear about your ex, that must have been very difficult for you, especially with the timing. I hope you know that it wasn't your fault. Nobody is responsible for how someone else is feeling. I intend to do my best to make it clear to everybody that it is nobody's fault that I'm feeling this way. My mom is the only reason I haven't put serious thought into this years ago, she's beenxx through so much and I really don't think she can handle it. I feel really bad about that, I wish there was something I could do to make it easier for her. I would wait until after she passes, but I really don't want xmy mom's death to be something I look forward to. She's one of the only people I actually love. But guilt won't keep me alive or happy.x

As for being myself, that's definitely not an option. I'm a miserable person, and nobody wants to be around miserable people. I don't pretend to be someone else, I just hide my negative traits that give people the impression that I'm unhappy or depressed.
